scope: Frozen post-unblinding physical-model upgrade: DESI LRGxELG RR-window-convolved forward model
motivation: Replace ideal-shell bin averaging by the actual DESI random-pair support and quantify even-to-odd leakage before any refit.

frozen_forward_model.wake: existing frozen hidden-state ell=1 theory; mass=0.06 eV, z_match=1100, pointwise cap=0.30
frozen_forward_model.odd_standard: existing linked relativistic plus leading wide-angle ell=1 benchmark
frozen_forward_model.even_standard: linear Kaiser LRGxELG ell=0,2,4 using the same fixed b_LRG=2.0, b_ELG=1.3 and per-bin growth rate
frozen_forward_model.application: conditional RR radial weighting within each frozen output (s,mu) support followed by the same Legendre projection

mandatory_pre_refit_checks: recomputed ideal-shell templates versus frozen pre-window templates
guardrail: Archive and interpret all window-only diagnostics before any matched-filter refit. Do not change the window resolution, input multipoles, theory components, bins, cuts, tracer ordering, or nuisance construction to increase the wake significance.
